description: Defines adapter classes for connecting various SDU notifiers and handlers within the F1AP, F1-U, RLC, and MAC layers of a telecommunications protocol stack, specifically for 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: f1c_rx_sdu_rlc_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1AP Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_rx_rlc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1-U Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_gateway_nru_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for F1-U Gateway to handle NR-U RX PDUs.

classes.name: rlc_rx_rrc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC RX to handle SDUs from RRC.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC TX to handle SDUs for F1-U.

classes.name: rlc_f1c_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-C TX data, handling transmit/delivery notifications.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-U TX data, handling transmit/delivery notifications.

classes.name: rlc_tx_control_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC TX control events like protocol failure and max retransmissions.

classes.name: rlc_tx_mac_buffer_state_updater
classes.description: Updates MAC with RLC buffer state information.

classes.name: mac_sdu_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for MAC SDU reception to RLC.

classes.name: mac_sdu_tx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for MAC SDU transmission from RLC.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the notifier to the respective handler/interface.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the notifier from the handler/interface.
